text_en: Flee for safety, O children of Benjamin, from the midst of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise a signal on Beth-haccherem; for evil looms out of the north, and great destruction.
text_cn: 本雅明子民，请你们逃出耶路撒冷，在特科亚吹号，在贝特革楞竖立旗帜！因为有一个灾祸，即一个巨大的毁灭，已由北方隐约出现。

text_en: I have likened daughter Zion to the loveliest pasture.
text_cn: 熙雍女郎仿佛美丽的草场，

text_en: Shepherds with their flocks shall come against her. They shall pitch their tents around her; they shall pasture, all in their places.
text_cn: 牧童领着自己的羊群向她进发，在她四周张设帐幕，各据一方牧放。

text_en: “Prepare war against her; up, and let us attack at noon! ” “Woe to us, for the day declines, the shadows of evening lengthen! ”
text_cn: “请你们备战，向她进攻；来，让我们在正午就上前进攻！我们真不幸！因为日已偏西，暮影已长！

text_en: “Up, and let us attack by night, and destroy her palaces! ”
text_cn: 不妨！就趁夜间上去，破坏她的宫阙。”

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts: Cut down her trees; cast up a siege ramp against Jerusalem. This is the city that must be punished; there is nothing but oppression within her.
text_cn: 因为万军的上主这样说：“你们该砍伐她的树木，堆起壁垒，围攻耶路撒冷，这该受罚的城市，因为在那里充满了压榨。

text_en: As a well keeps its water fresh, so she keeps fresh her wickedness; violence and destruction are heard within her; sickness and wounds are ever before me.
text_cn: 泉源怎样涌出水，她就怎样涌出邪恶；从那里只可听到强暴和迫害，我只看见疾病和疮痍。

text_en: Take warning, O Jerusalem, or I shall turn from you in disgust, and make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷！你应接受训戒，免得我的心疏远你，使你荒凉，成为没有人居住的地方。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Glean thoroughly as a vine the remnant of Israel; like a grape-gatherer, pass your hand again over its branches.
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：“你应像收拾葡萄，把以色列的遗民收拾净尽；又如收割的人向枝条再伸出你的手来。”

text_en: To whom shall I speak and give warning, that they may hear? See, their ears are closed, they cannot listen. The word of the Lord is to them an object of scorn; they take no pleasure in it.
text_cn: 我应对谁说，应警告谁，使他们听信我呢？看，他们的耳朵迟钝不灵，不能留心细听；看，上主的话对他们已成了笑柄，一点也不感兴趣。

text_en: But I am full of the wrath of the Lord ; I am weary of holding it in. Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the gatherings of young men as well; both husband and wife shall be taken, the old folk and the very aged.
text_cn: 为此，我满怀上主的忿怒，我已无法再控制：“只得将忿怒泄在街上的孩童和青年的队伍身上，因为男人和女人，年长和年老的人，都要被掳去；

text_en: Their houses shall be turned over to others, their fields and wives together; for I will stretch out my hand against the inhabitants of the land, says the Lord .
text_cn: 他们的住宅、庄田和妻室，都要归于他人，因为我要向本地的居民伸出我的手──上主的断语。”

text_en: For from the least to the greatest of them, everyone is greedy for unjust gain; and from prophet to priest, everyone deals falsely.
text_cn: 实在，从最小的到最大的，都贪财图利；从先知到司祭，都欺诈行事，

text_en: They have treated the wound of my people carelessly, saying, “Peace, peace, ” when there is no peace.
text_cn: 草率治疗我人民的疮痍说：“好了，好了！”其实却没有好。

text_en: They acted shamefully, they committed abomination; yet they were not ashamed, they did not know how to blush. Therefore they shall fall among those who fall; at the time that I punish them, they shall be overthrown, says the Lord .
text_cn: 他们既行事可憎，就理当知耻；可是，他们不但毫不知耻，反而连羞愧也不知是什么；为此，他们要与倒毙者一同倒毙，在我降罚他们时，都要一蹶（jué）不振──上主说。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Stand at the crossroads, and look, and ask for the ancient paths, where the good way lies; and walk in it, and find rest for your souls. But they said, “We will not walk in it. ”
text_cn: 上主这样说：“你们应站在交叉路口，观察探问旧路；那一条是好路，就在那路上走，你们的心灵必获安宁。”他们却答说：“我们偏不走。”

text_en: Also I raised up sentinels for you: “Give heed to the sound of the trumpet! ” But they said, “We will not give heed. ”
text_cn: “我给你们派驻哨兵， 你们应注意号声！”他们却答说：“我们偏不注意。”

text_en: Therefore hear, O nations, and know, O congregation, what will happen to them.
text_cn: 为此，万民！你们应该细听；群众！你们应知道他们的遭遇。

text_en: Hear, O earth; I am going to bring disaster on this people, the fruit of their schemes, because they have not given heed to my words; and as for my teaching, they have rejected it.
text_cn: 大地！注意：看，我必给这百姓带来灾祸，作他们失节的苦果，因为他们没有听从我的言辞，抛弃了我的法律。

text_en: Of what use to me is frankincense that comes from Sheba, or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor are your sacrifices pleasing to me.
text_cn: 那些来自舍巴的乳香，出自远方的香蒲，于我有何用？你们的全燔祭不受悦纳，你们的牺牲不乐我意。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : See, I am laying before this people stumbling blocks against which they shall stumble; parents and children together, neighbor and friend shall perish.
text_cn: 为此，上主这样说，“看，我将给这人民设下绊脚石，使父子一起绊倒，使邻居和朋友同趋灭亡。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord : See, a people is coming from the land of the north, a great nation is stirring from the farthest parts of the earth.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“看，有一个民族从北方前来，有一个强大的异邦从地极兴起，

text_en: They grasp the bow and the javelin, they are cruel and have no mercy, their sound is like the roaring sea; they ride on horses, equipped like a warrior for battle, against you, O daughter Zion!
text_cn: 紧握弓戈，残忍无情，像海啸一般喧嚷，骑着战马，万众一心，严阵准备向你进攻，熙雍女郎！”

text_en: “We have heard news of them, our hands fall helpless; anguish has taken hold of us, pain as of a woman in labor.
text_cn: 我们听到了这消息，束手无策，不胜忧虑，痛苦得有如临产的妇女。

text_en: Do not go out into the field, or walk on the road; for the enemy has a sword, terror is on every side. ”
text_cn: 你们不要到田间去，不要在路上徘徊，因为敌人正在撕杀，四处令人恐怖。

text_en: O my poor people, put on sackcloth, and roll in ashes; make mourning as for an only child, most bitter lamentation: for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
text_cn: 我的女儿──人民──你该穿上麻衣，辗转于灰尘，悲哀伤心痛哭，如丧独子，因为劫夺者要突然来袭击我们！

text_en: I have made you a tester and a refiner among my people so that you may know and test their ways.
text_cn: 我立了你作我人民的考察员，原是为叫你认识并考察他们的行径。

text_en: They are all stubbornly rebellious, going about with slanders; they are bronze and iron, all of them act corruptly.
text_cn: 他们尽是极顽固的叛徒，往来播散流言，确是坏透了的破铜烂铁。

text_en: The bellows blow fiercely, the lead is consumed by the fire; in vain the refining goes on, for the wicked are not removed.
text_cn: 风箱猛吹，虽有烈火，但铅仍不溶化；炼工徒然锻炼，渣滓总炼不掉。

text_en: They are called “rejected silver, ” for the Lord has rejected them.
text_cn: 人都称他们为“抛弃的银渣”，因为上主已将他们抛弃。
